plan.title: Add and edit a Creator column

steps.note: Open the eRFX event creation screen.
Provide the mandatory event title required for a valid creation flow.
Configure the event as an RFQ so the RFQ pricing sheet is shown.
Apply a pricing template before adding line items and columns.
Create a data row in the RFQ sheet for the Creator column.
Verify that Add Columns offers exactly the Creator and Participant groups.
Verify that the Creator list contains all six expected column types.
Select a representative Creator column to add to the sheet.
Assert that the selected Creator column appears in the RFQ sheet.
Assert that the buyer can edit the new Creator column's cell.
